query: the photo of me at the Taj Mahal
notes: ABSENCE CONTROL FOR THE VISUAL PATH, added 2026-08-26 with CLIP. q019 used to be the row that could not be answered, and CLIP answered it - an experiment quietly destroying its own falsifier. This row is absent the way q020 is absent: no such photograph exists in the corpus, so no OCR, no CLIP and no future model can find it. It specifically targets the VISUAL index, because a text-only absence control cannot detect a visual system inventing matches. CLIP returns a nearest neighbour for every query, always, so this row is what proves the system can still say no.

Until data/corpus/group_photo.jpg exists this row must refuse - and the day it is added, this row flips to visual_recall and becomes the strongest before/after pair in the project, alongside q019.

query: my college ID card
notes: THE FLAGSHIP ROW, and the only end-to-end test of the visual path. Measured at ingest 2026-09-04: college_id.jpg produced 0 text chunks and 1 CLIP embedding. Tesseract reads nothing off laminated plastic - PRODUCT.md asserts this and the ingest confirmed it rather than quoting it - so there is no text route to this document at all. It classified as document_type 'id_card' from the filename. HONEST LIMIT: the query shares the tokens 'college' and 'id' with the filename, so a pass here does not on its own prove CLIP did the work; filename and document_type are also live routes. A row that isolates CLIP would need a description sharing no tokens with the filename, and is worth adding separately rather than by weakening this one, which is phrased the way a person would ask.

query: that rectangular plastic pass with my face printed on it
notes: ISOLATES THE VISUAL PATH, and currently FAILS at rank 2. Written alongside q024 rather than by weakening it. Shares no token with 'college_id.jpg', and verified not to trigger the id_card vocabulary ('identity card', 'student id', 'college id', 'employee id'), so neither the filename nor document_type is a live route and only CLIP can answer it. Measured 2026-09-04: returns college_id.jpg at rank 2, score 0.0164 = 1/(60+1). That is the rank-1 cap on image-only documents, unchanged. The tie-break added the same day fixes q024 because a type opinion exists there to break the tie; with no type opinion the tie falls through to own-modality strength, the competing text hit is above MIN_SIMILARITY_UNCALIBRATED, and text keeps rank 1. So q024 passing does NOT mean visual retrieval reaches rank 1 - this row is what keeps that distinction measurable, and it should stay failing until the cap is removed rather than routed around.
